sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234485 (per-site catalog)

values.note: recreation.gov 2026 peak season (May 15 - Sept 24): $22 a night per standard site; group site priced separately. Extra vehicle $5 a night, collected at the campground. The Forest Service page (last updated April 2025) still shows $18 a single site and says 'Visit recreation.gov for all fee info.'

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234485/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-24: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC': 22) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234485 (notice: 'an extra vehicle charge of $5.00/vehicle per night will be collected at the campground') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/big-creek-campground ('Single Site: $18 per night', 'Visit recreation.gov for all fee info.'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234485 (notice: 'Electric, water and sewer hookups are not provided. There are 2 hand pumps for filling of your water jugs.') + catalog (all sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 22 sites, 12 reservable and 10 walk-up first-come, plus a group area for up to 200 in the middle of the campground. recreation.gov gives few site lengths (one each of 32, 39 and 48 ft).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234485 ('Big Creek Campground has 22 campsites, 12 of which are reservable and 10 are walk-up, first come, first serve sites'; 'A group camping area ... can accommodate up to 200 guests') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/big-creek-campground ('a hosted, 22-site campground') + catalog (Max Vehicle Length mostly blank), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from two hand pumps, 'not for filling your RV so please come with your water full.' Boat ramp; campground host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234485 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. The water is in 2 locations and are hand pumps. They are not for filling your RV'; amenities 'Boat Ramp', 'Host') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/big-creek-campground ('vault toilets ... and potable water. There is a boat ramp for river launching'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use: Mid May - September'; the concessionaire runs it in the summer months.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/big-creek-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Mid May - September'; 'managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds, during the summer months'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 12 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 10 walk-up first-come (marked W at the campground; recreation.gov can't show whether they are taken, so call). A reservation is held until 11 am the day after arrival; reservation holders may not move to a walk-up site. 16 consecutive nights (32 a year on recreation.gov); the Forest Service page also mentions a 14-day limit. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234485 (overview: '12 of which are reservable and 10 are walk-up, first come, first serve sites. The stay limit is 16 consecutive nights.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 'Each Year'; notices on walk-up sites, holding and check-in/out) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/big-creek-campground ('Stay limit 16 days'; 'This campground has a 14-day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 50% off standard site fees with an Interagency Senior or Access Pass (also Golden Age/Access Passports); not the Interagency Annual pass, and not on extra vehicles or group sites.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/big-creek-campground ('A 50% discount on all standard site fees and day use fees will be offered to holders of the Golden Age and Golden Access Passports, as well as holders of the Interagency Senior and Access Passes.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF campground along the North Fork Flathead River, 20 mi north of Columbia Falls on the North Fork Road (about 10 mi paved, 9 gravel), ~2 mi south of Glacier NP's Camas Creek entrance. Concession-run in summer by Flathead Valley Campgrounds. Max recommended trailer ~40 ft. The Glacier Institute's Big Creek Outdoor Education Center is across the road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $22 (recreation.gov 2026; FS page still shows $18), no hookups, 22 sites (12 reservable / 10 walk-up), vault toilets, hand-pump water, recreation.gov booking with some first-come sites. Added season mid-May to September (FS), 16-night limit, the senior/access 50% discount for this campground (was inherited), concessionaire. Not stated: individual-site booking window (6-month inherited left), max rig length. Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: (406) 752-7924, Flathead Valley Campgrounds (the summer concessionaire), on both the Forest Service page and recreation.gov; the concessionaire's site is flatheadvalleycampgrounds.com (not checked).
The Forest Service page (updated April 2025) lists $18 a single site and both a 14-day and a 16-day stay limit; recreation.gov's 2026 rate is $22 and its limit 16 consecutive nights.
